app.name: SimShredder
app.privacy: Runs locally. Your character data stays on this device.

home.title: WoW gear simulation
home.description: Compare gear, gems, enchants, and upgrades with SimulationCraft.
home.recentEmptyBody: Your completed and interrupted runs will appear here.

runtime.title: SimulationCraft
runtime.missingDetail: Install an official Retail Live build to run simulations.
runtime.damagedDetail: The installed build needs to be checked in Settings.
runtime.installBody: SimShredder downloads the pinned Retail Live build directly from the official SimulationCraft server, verifies its size and SHA-256, and installs it only for your account.
runtime.noAdmin: No administrator access, system PATH, or system-wide install is required.
runtime.catalogStale: Build {{build}} was removed from the official nightly server. Keep using the installed build and check again after the signed catalog is updated.
runtime.networkUnavailable: SimulationCraft updates could not be checked because the network is unavailable. The installed build remains active.
runtime.catalogUnavailable: The signed SimulationCraft catalog is currently unavailable. The installed build remains active; try again later.
runtime.installFailed: SimulationCraft could not be installed or verified. The installed build remains active.
runtime.updatePromptTitle: A newer SimulationCraft build is available
runtime.updatePromptQuestion: Update now? SimShredder checks once per day, and your current build stays active until the new build is verified.
runtime.sourceNote: SimulationCraft is separate GPL-3.0 software and is not bundled with SimShredder.

icons.title: WoW icons
icons.body: Skill, buff, talent, and equipment icons use safe built-in placeholders while remote providers are disabled.
icons.errorTitle: Icon cache could not be managed

tooltip.openError: The external page could not be opened.

storage.title: Storage locations
storage.body: Choose separate folders for simulation history, SimulationCraft, icon cache, and exports.
storage.moveWarning: Changing a location starts using that folder immediately. Existing files are not moved or deleted; choose the previous folder again to restore access to them.
storage.errorTitle: Storage locations could not be changed

importPage.title: Character profiles
importPage.body: Reuse a saved character or import a SimulationCraft AddOn export or .simc file.
importPage.sourcePlaceholder: Paste your SimulationCraft AddOn export or .simc text here…
importPage.dropHint: You can also drop a .simc file here.
importPage.errorTitle: The profile could not be imported
importPage.fileTooLarge: Profile files are limited to 2 MiB.

profiles.title: Saved characters
profiles.body: Reuse the last input and settings saved for each character.
profiles.empty: No character profiles have been saved yet. Reviewing an input saves it here.
profiles.deleteBody: This removes the saved current and previous inputs from the reusable profile list. Simulation history, results, and exported files are kept.
profiles.errorTitle: The character profile could not be updated
profiles.armoryBody: The saved profile input will be replaced with current Armory data. AddOn-only bag items and manual input may be cleared. Simulation history is kept, and the previous input can be restored.
profiles.armoryUnavailable: Armory authentication and the API broker will be enabled in 1.0. The reload workflow is present but no network request is made in 0.x.

quick.title: Review simulation input

inputCompatibility.title: Input compatibility
inputCompatibility.body: SimShredder edits recognized fields and preserves the remaining SimC syntax unchanged.

reasons.preservedNotEditable: Preserved exactly and delegated to SimulationCraft
reasons.executionBlocked: Not executable in the local single-character workflow

quick.optimalRaidHelp: Apply SimC's standard optimal raid buffs and debuffs.
quick.bloodlustHelp: Allow SimC to apply Bloodlust using the configured trigger.
quick.consumablesHelp: Use the potion, flask, food, augmentation, and weapon enhancement from the imported profile.
quick.reportDetailsHelp: Collect ability, buff, resource, and sample action details.
quick.fixedTimeHelp: Do not end the fight early when the target would otherwise die.
quick.reportPetsSeparatelyHelp: Show pets as separate actors in the full report.
quick.customAplHelp: When set, replaces the imported/default action list. Only actions directives are accepted.
quick.customOptionsHelp: One key=value per line. Safe combat, buff, report, latency, and Midnight options are accepted; I/O, network, hardware, and extra-actor options are blocked.
quick.generatedHelp: This exact input is stored with the job and covered by the cache key.
quick.errorTitle: Character Analysis could not be prepared
quick.importFirst: Import and review a profile before configuring the analysis.

topGear.title: Compare gear and upgrades
topGear.body: Compare worn and bag gear with virtual gems, enchants, and upgrades. SimShredder respects each currency reserve and verifies finalists at higher precision.
topGear.importFirst: Import a Retail Live profile before configuring Gear Optimizer.
topGear.candidateGearHelp: Select the worn and bag items to include. Lock a slot to keep its currently equipped item.
topGear.itemSearchBoundary: Name search needs versioned official game data and remains unavailable in 0.x. Exact item IDs and SimC options work offline.
topGear.invalidItemId: Enter a positive numeric item ID.
topGear.invalidItemOptions: Item options must be comma-separated key=value entries.
topGear.noCatalystCandidates: No confirmed catalyst variants are available. Charges will not change the result until a catalyst variant is added.
topGear.setMetadataHelp: Assign the same set group to virtual variants below before applying a minimum. SimShredder does not guess missing set metadata.
topGear.talentHelp: Saved loadouts found in the profile can be included in the same comparison.
topGear.profileOptionsHelp: Compare profile-provided consumables or add an exact SimC value. Use disabled for none.
topGear.omniumHelp: Compare the imported Omnium Folio configuration with additional encoded configurations in the same Gear Optimizer run.
topGear.omniumExactHelp: Enter the exact omnium_talents value produced by SimulationCraft-compatible input. SimShredder does not guess seasonal effects.
topGear.noOmnium: No Omnium Folio override in the imported profile
topGear.noOverride: No override in the imported profile
topGear.simcValuePlaceholder: disabled or an exact encoded value
topGear.enhancementPolicyLabel: How should item upgrades be compared?
topGear.policy_max_potential_help: Default. Each owned item is compared at its confirmed maximum rank; your exact equipped setup remains as the baseline.
topGear.policy_budget_constrained_help: Compares every confirmed consecutive rank from the current rank to the maximum without spending reserved currency.
topGear.policy_current_state_help: Compares the items exactly as imported and does not generate upgrade ranks.
topGear.metadataSource_unknown: Source: unknown; no higher rank will be assumed
topGear.confirmUpgradeMetadataHelp: SimShredder preserves these fields exactly and does not infer missing ranks or costs.
topGear.debugUpgradeRequired: Upgrade data is missing. Open an item upgrade vendor in WoW, run /simc debug, and import the new text. Until then, each item remains at its current state; exact manual variants are still available.
topGear.debugUpgradeCurrentOnly: Upgrade paths were preserved, but no automatic candidate has fully verified cost semantics. These items remain at their current state; exact manual variants are still available.
topGear.upgradeDiagnostic: Line {{line}} could not be used ({{code}}). The associated item remains at its current state.
topGear.currencyNote: Enter effective costs after any account or character discount. The timestamp is refreshed whenever these values change.
topGear.noCostedUpgradeCandidates: No upgrade candidates with confirmed costs are available. Currency balances will not change the result until exact upgrade candidates are added.
topGear.automaticPrecision: Runs automatically at {{low}}%, {{medium}}%, then {{high}}% target error. Confidence bounds decide which candidates continue.
topGear.virtualBody: Worn and bag items come from the imported profile. Add allowed future gem, enchant, item-level, or upgrade states without changing the game.
topGear.estimated: The safety cap truncates the emitted search. Results will be marked estimated.
topGear.job_running: SimulationCraft is processing the current candidate batch.
topGear.job_succeeded: This stage is complete. The next stage starts automatically.
topGear.job_succeeded_advance: This stage is complete. Continue when you are ready for the next verification stage.
topGear.job_failed: This stage failed. Review the diagnostic below before retrying.
topGear.job_canceled: This stage was canceled and can be retried.
topGear.job_interrupted: The app closed during this stage. Retry the unfinished work.
topGear.continueStage: Continue to the next verified stage
topGear.bestBaseline: Your equipped setup is the best result
topGear.bestSidegrade: The top result is statistically tied with your equipped setup
topGear.bestUpgrade: The top result improves on your equipped setup
topGear.bestInterpretation: Treat differences within the combined error as tied. The ranked table keeps the equipped baseline and every verified finalist visible.
topGear.referenceHelp: Select any ranking row to use that loadout as the comparison reference.
topGear.useAsReference: Use rank {{rank}} as the comparison reference
topGear.noEquipmentDetails: No equipment details were recorded for this loadout.
topGear.rankStepError: Add upgrades one rank at a time and provide the resulting item level. Select the new virtual rank as the base to add the next rank.
topGear.noVirtualChange: Change at least one gem, enchant, or single upgrade rank before adding a variant.

jobsPage.noJob: No Character Analysis run is selected.

resultsPage.noActions: This report contains no action breakdown.
resultsPage.noResources: This report contains no resource summary.
resultsPage.noBuffs: This report contains no buff summary.
resultsPage.aplHelp: The first 100 recorded actions from SimC. This is evidence from the run, not an APL editor.
resultsPage.noApl: This report contains no recorded action sequence.
resultsPage.htmlSafety: HTML is shown as source text and is never inserted into the privileged app document.
resultsPage.truncated: This log was truncated at the bounded storage limit.
resultsPage.exportError: The verified artifacts could not be exported

historyPage.title: Run history
historyPage.body: Simulation runs remain on this device. Open unfinished work in Runs or inspect a completed result.
historyPage.deleteActive: Cancel the active run before deleting it
historyPage.deleteBody: The run record and artifacts used only by this run will be permanently deleted. Shared cache artifacts, exported files, and other runs are not affected.
